name: Mini Tofu Shawarma with Cucumber-Tomato Salad & Mint Yogurt

instructions.primary_message: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a large baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tomatoes
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 small pkg fresh mint

instructions.primary_message: Place oil and spices in a large bowl; stir to combine the spice paste.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp cumin, ground
1 ½ tsp paprika
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp cinnamon, ground
½ tsp cardamom, ground
½ tsp nutmeg, ground
½ tsp cloves, ground
½ tsp turmeric, ground
¼ tsp cayenne pepper

instructions.primary_message: Medium dice tofu, add to the bowl with the spice paste, and gently toss to coat. Divide tofu between two baking sheets and spread out in a single layer. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, tossing halfway through, until tofu is golden brown, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place vinegar, oil, salt, and pepper in the reserved bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp red wine vinegar
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and thinly slice onion; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Small dice tomatoes. Peel, trim, and small dice cucumbers. Add both to the bowl and stir to combine the salad; set aside.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the mint, along with yogurt, salt, and pepper; stir to combine the yogurt sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
2 ¼ cups plain Greek yogurt
½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Warm tortillas in a skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
To serve, fill tortillas with tofu, cucumber-tomato salad, and mint yogurt. Divide between plates and enjoy!
